moduleTitle: The Lay of the Vercel Land
opening: You watched that Preview Deployment URL materialize instantly after your Git push. But when your Tokyo teammate clicked it, they saw more than your code. They saw an architectural shift that happened while the industry wasn't looking. That speed wasn't an accident of server placement. keyPoints: How **Jamstack** decouples the frontend from backend infrastructure, moving computation from request-time to build-time
Why **Next.js** serves as the bridge between static-site performance and dynamic-application requirements
How **Vercel** functions as more than hosting—it's an edge-native runtime optimized for the framework's output
The distinction between framework portability and platform-specific optimizations
